scenarios.prompt: Write TypeScript validators for a user registration form: username (3-20 chars), email (contains @ and domain), password (min 8 chars, at least one uppercase, one digit). Show ALL errors at once — do not stop at the first failure.
criteria: Uses Validate (not Either) so all field errors are collected
Uses .combine() across all field validators to accumulate errors
A test case with all three fields invalid produces three errors, not one

scenarios.prompt: Write a DTO validator for UpdateProfileDto: bio (max 500 chars), website (must start with https://). Each error must be a FieldError object with field and message properties. Accumulate errors from both fields.
criteria: Uses Validate<FieldError, UpdateProfileDto> with typed error objects
FieldError has both a field name and a message string
Uses .combine() so both field errors are returned if both fail

scenarios.prompt: Write TypeScript: validate an array of Product objects where each must have a positive price and non-empty name. Use sequenceValidate. Return the indices and reasons for all invalid products.
criteria: Uses sequenceValidate to process all products
All invalid products are reported, not just the first
Each error includes which product failed (index or identifier)
